_readme: Exact-fingerprint exceptions for Gate B. A rule matches a drift only when
path, kind, canonical_hash AND consumer_hash all equal - if either side's
semantics change, the exception stops applying and the drift fails strict CI.

exceptions.reason: signature optionality: canonical keeps signature optional (v0.x additive contract); the consumer requires it and closes the world. Alignment tracked as the JS signed/unsigned split.
